run_create_model_cli: run the CLI to create a model from the model zoo with a specified builder and arch_name
create_model_from_zoo: create a model from the model zoo factory using a builder name and optional arch arguments
convert_model_to_jit: convert a PyTorch model to TorchScript JIT format with optional batch norm fusion
convert_model_to_int8: convert a PyTorch model to int8 quantized TorchScript using graph mode post-training quantization
print_model_flops: print per-layer FLOPs for a model given input data shape using flops_utils
